item.tib: dmar byang 'phrul gyi me long dam chos phyag rgya chen po las rang rig dmar thag bcad pa rgyab skyor rin chen 'phreng
item.coloph: kye ho tshe dbang rig gsal mchog khyed la bstan pa'i gdams pa 'di/ man ngag nang gi yang snying ste/ phyi rabs rnal 'byor skal pa can/ ri khrod 'grims pa'i cha rkyen te/ skal med dag la sa ma ya/ rnal 'byor kha lta can la ma shor cig rgya rgya rgya/ bka'i brgyad pa mi 'chad pa'i/ rdo rje legs pas bya ra mdzod/ ces gsungs nas/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin la gdams so/ de nas rig 'dzin rnams rim par brgyud nas/ las grub ye shes rigs kyi mkha' 'gro yi/ gzhi bdag gnyen po sku lha zang 'phru'i zhol du/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag gyis (la) snyan du brgyud nas/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par bya/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'dis/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun bdag med don rtogs shog/
